name: preview_member_invite
title: Preview inviting a team member
description:
What inviting a person to this workspace by email would do, without sending anything: a
`summary` (who, as what, seats in use) and a `confirmation` code valid for 10 minutes for
`invite_member`. They can be invited as a manager or an agent, never an admin.

role.description: `client_agent` (default) answers conversations; `client_manager` also sees the team's work.

name.description: Their name, if known. They can change it when they sign up.
